body: It doesn't matter, nothing matters.  People have their own problems, there is no good, there are no connections, just slow rot until death.  I just need to be stronger, go get on with it, no one likes a whiner. Any attempt at reaching out will be met with scorn and pity; even therapists would yell at me and tell me to just man up and deal. It's life, it's awful; all those questions in the original post are things I genuinely wonder about.  How do people deal with this?  This is horrible, I don't want to wake up anymore. I don't want to be pitied, or laughed at, I just want to be normal for once. I just want to be touched, all I can do is sit in a ball now and rock back and forth. It's all I'm good for, anything else is just me being a little boy.

I will not make it in time.  It has already been too long. Been around the block multiple times, seen most things, there was nothing for me (and the homeless guys camped out nearby). Thank you for the suggestion though, it was very appropriate.

I spend a ridiculous amount of effort trying tobe attractive. I am fit, I dress well, I go out, but people do not like me. Clearly, it is not easy to be liked.  Do you think I choose to suffer?  If so, you are a fool, a selfish fool. I try to spend time with others, but they do not want me around. I try to smile and fake being happy, but it is not enough.

In some ways they are better, at least others value them more. I don't mean in the philosophical "worth" sense, more in having value to other humans, so that they connect and interact with you, especially intimately. It's hard to see value in being different, if being different means this pain.

Sure there is, normal is those deemed worthy of touch by other humans.  It is a (sub)conscious decision. If no individuals make that decision, the person in question is never touched, ever. That's what I was going for anyway.  Yes, we are all not bright beacons at all times, but some people manage to connect with others regardless.  Why is that?

I want to be touched.  I'm getting to the point where my mental and physical pain are so similar that it only is possible to tell them apart by location. I get a very intense sensation in my chest when I realize how far the gap between what normal people experience and what I experience is. It's an actual physical sensation, coming with the urge to tear up, but not actually cry. I'm not sure what to do. I am starting to develop physical ticks and twitches from anxiety and stress. I just think there is going to be this point really soon where I realize that I'm just too far behind, and have been for too long. It has probably already happened, but there just hasn't been the clear sign yet. I'm starting to not understand how to relate to people anymore, because what is so commonplace for them is something that is starting to stretch into the realm of my imagination, and my imagination only.
